subject: Security discovery: data lifecycle & log/backups questions
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Holt <sarah.holt@medsight.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medsight.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T14:12:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: Security & data lifecycle questions from today

Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and a list of items we promised to follow up on from the demo and compliance discussion: 

Summary (short):
- You asked about SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA posture and our ability to provide a BAA.
- Specific asks on data deletion SLOs for customer data and how that carries through backups and long-term snapshots.
- Log retention duration for audit purposes vs operational logs.

Action items for you:
1) Please confirm the primary compliance drivers for MediSight (HIPAA mandatory? GDPR as controller/processor?).
2) Attached is our vendor security questionnaire (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). If you can return that, we can map answers directly to your policy.

From our side (what we'll do next):
- Priyom will prepare a short note on our backup snapshot lifecycle and deletion workflow so you can see how deletion requests propagate to backups.
- I'll pull a draft BAA for initial review and share proposed SLA language for deletion/retention windows.
- We will confirm SOC 2 timeline and any attestations we can share in advance.

Specific clarifying questions that will help speed review:
- For retention: do you need logs and backups to be deleted within the same window as live data, or can backups have a longer retention (e.g., 6–24 months) for audit/recovery purposes?
- For deletion requests: do you require cryptographic/forensic deletion from all copies within X days, or is removal from live systems + eventual purge from backups acceptable (please specify target days)?

Proposed next step: 30-minute security deep-dive next week (Priyom + Redwood legal + your security ops) to go through the questionnaire and backup lifecycle. If that works, propose Tue/Wed next week — share times that suit you.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (stated fields)

Thanks — Ben

From: Sarah Holt <sarah.holt@medsight.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medsight.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & data lifecycle questions from today

Ben — thanks, useful recap. Answers inline below.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: We are currently operating without SOC 2 but have a Program to reach SOC 2 Type II; target audit completion is end of August 2027. Evidence requests before that are common; we'll need control mappings.
- HIPAA: Mandatory — MediSight processes protected health information. We will require a signed BAA prior to any production data exchange.
- GDPR: We are the data controller for EU-resident data; Redwood would be a processor for that subset. Standard processor commitments expected.

On retention/deletion specifics:
- Live data deletion: must be removable upon request; target is 30 days maximum to complete deletion workflows and confirm.
- Logs: audit logs are required to be retained for at least 12 months for compliance/audits; those can be retained separately from primary PII with appropriate pseudonymization where possible.
- Backups: our policy prefers that backups containing PHI be retained no longer than 24 months, but we also need the ability to request prioritized deletion of customer data from backups if a validated deletion request is received. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support expedited removal from backups or whether you rely on normal backup rotation?

We attached our vendor requirements summary (MedSight_Vendor_Requirements.pdf) — it highlights the BAA + deletion expectations in section 2.3.

Next steps: happy to do the security deep-dive. Tue/Wed next week works; prefer Wed morning PT. We'll also return the questionnaire by Friday if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah Holt
Head of Security & Privacy, MediSight Health
sarah.holt@medsight.com

Marissa / Priyom — FYI, Sarah confirmed HIPAA + controller/processor split and asked for the ability to request prioritized deletion from backups (not just waiting for rotation). Important asks: BAA required, 30-day max for deletion confirmation on live data, logs 12 months, backups ideally <= 24 months but must support expedited deletion on request.

Priyom — can you put together a short note (1 page) describing:
- How Redwood handles backup snapshots (frequency, retention by default, encryption at rest AND whether snapshots reference immutable object storage)
- Whether we can support targeted removal of a tenant/customer from backups and the practical SLA for that (e.g., we can guarantee removal from live stores within 24h, backups purged on next compaction/rotation cycle — typically 30/90/365 days, unless we offer custom retention terms in contract).

Also need to check with Legal on BAA lead time and whether we should offer an addendum that shortens backup retention for healthcare customers in the contract.

I'll draft proposed contract language once Priyom gives the technical constraints.

Thanks — Ben

Subject: Proposed language & next steps — data deletion, backups, SOC2/BAA

Hi Sarah / Tom — following up with concrete next steps and draft language so you can share with your procurement and security teams. Attached: BAA_Draft_Redwood_v1.pdf and a short tech note from Priyom (summary below).

1) SOC 2:
- Redwood will share current control mappings and our SOC readiness summary. We anticipate SOC 2 Type II attestation in August 2027 and can provide interim evidence (control documentation) this quarter.

2) HIPAA / BAA:
- We can provide a standard BAA; initial draft attached (BAA_Draft_Redwood_v1.pdf). Legal is available to iterate. We will not enable production PHI exchange until a signed BAA is in place.

3) Data deletion & backups (proposed contractual language):
- Live data: Redwood will remove customer-identifiable data from live production stores within 24 hours of an approved deletion request and will confirm completion in writing.
- Backups & snapshots: Redwood maintains backups for disaster recovery. Default backup retention is 90 days. For healthcare customers, Redwood will offer a contract option to set backup retention to a maximum of 24 months or shorter as agreed. Expedited deletion requests for tenant-level removal from backups will be handled as follows: Redwood will purge references to the customer's data on the next backup compaction cycle and will take commercially reasonable efforts to accelerate removal where feasible; for customers requiring strict short-term deletion from backups, Redwood recommends a contractual retention term (e.g., 30/90 days) and will supply additional controls (encryption key management, customer-isolated snapshots) where available.

- Logs: Audit logs required for compliance can be retained up to 12 months by default; logs can be pseudonymized for audit retention where possible.

4) Attachments & artifacts: vendor questionnaire received; please send back completed questionnaire to speed the mapping. Link to draft BAA and HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-2027-1120. DocuSign placeholder for contract items: https://docusign.com/placeholder/medsight-security-nda

Proposed next step: Security deep-dive (30 min) on 2027-05-25 16:00 PT — Priyom will walk backup lifecycle and legal can join for BAA questions. Please confirm or propose alternate times.

If that aligns, we'll follow up with a short one-page tech note from Priyom and a redlineable BAA for your procurement.

Thanks — Ben
